clue.text: Seeing the head about everything, one is calm

indicators.note: the head is placed around the other pieces, so about signals one piece enclosing another

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
all means everything
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone who feels in charge of everything is at peace with the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'calm' is a verb here, not an adjective; 'Seeing' and 'is' are link words, and 'about' signals the head going round the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To palliate is to soothe or ease pain or distress, a synonym of the verb calm.

clue.text: Promise quietly to settle

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly
to light on something is to settle or land on it, as a bird alights

explanation.surface: A vow made softly to resolve a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: To plight one's troth is an old phrase for pledging, so plight is a synonym of promise as a verb.

clue.text: Distinction bringing unexpected result

indicators.note: an unexpected outcome is one that comes out differently, signalling the letters of result are rearranged

explanation.surface: Winning honours thanks to a surprise outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre can mean glory or renown, the shine of fame, so it matches distinction.

clue.text: Pictures of perfect insects

explanation.surface: Photos of flawless bugs.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something is to envisage it in the mind; an imago is the fully developed adult insect, with a plural ending in -ines.

clue.text: Gather he was a member of Robin's band

definitions.text: he was a member of Robin's band

explanation.surface: Someone who once rode with the Sherwood outlaws collects things.
explanation.walkthrough: Robin Hood's band of outlaws included the jolly Friar Tuck.
explanation.definitionFit: To tuck fabric is to gather it into folds; Friar Tuck was the outlaw cleric of the Robin Hood legend.

clue.text: Reproached for creating bedlam

indicators.note: creating suggests making something new out of the letters of bedlam, so they are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone was told off for causing chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; 'creating' tells you to rearrange BEDLAM.
explanation.definitionFit: To be reproached is to be criticised and held responsible, a synonym of being found at fault.

clue.text: Scope for manoeuvring appears general on the course

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general in the American Civil War
a way is a route or course

explanation.surface: A military commander on a racecourse has room to manoeuvre.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeway is slack or freedom of action, room allowed to move within limits.

clue.text: Fruit in the Chinese language

explanation.surface: A piece of produce found in Chinese speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandarin is a small citrus like a tangerine; Mandarin is also the standard spoken form of Chinese.

clue.text: Just the same, people should get a gift

parts.note: do is the abbreviation of ditto, meaning the same again
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A remark that everyone deserves a present equally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should get a' is link wording; DO is the written shorthand for ditto.
explanation.definitionFit: A donation is something given freely, such as money to charity, so it is a present.

clue.text: An example of the well-favoured position

parts.note: in means fashionable or in favour
a stance is a posture or position

explanation.surface: A model case of a privileged standing.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is a case or specimen illustrating something, so it means an example.

clue.text: Some clever no-nonsense guy

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bright, practical fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: The name runs from the end of 'clever' into 'no-nonsense'.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernon is a man's name, and guy is informal for a man, so the definition points to any male name.

clue.text: Transport a front for a mobile home

parts.note: a car is a means of transport
the van is the vanguard, the front of an army

explanation.surface: Advice on choosing a vehicle to pull a touring home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; VAN for the front comes from vanguard.
explanation.definitionFit: A caravan is a towed trailer fitted out for living in, a home on wheels.

clue.text: The solitary woman with German following

parts.note: her is a pronoun for a woman
mit is the German word for with

explanation.surface: A lone lady accompanied by a man from Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: A solitary, as a noun, is a recluse living alone, often for religious reasons.

clue.text: Waterfall can make many a sailing man go about

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
a tar is a sailor
to act is to behave or go about doing something

explanation.surface: Big water features could send lots of mariners off course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can make' is a link phrase between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A cataract is a large, steep waterfall, such as those on the Nile.

clue.text: Afternoon meal to celebrate, causing some irritation

parts.note: tea is a light British meal taken in the afternoon
to sing is to celebrate in song

explanation.surface: Merriment over the afternoon cuppa annoys someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Teasing behaviour pokes fun and provokes, so it annoys mildly.

clue.text: Foreign cash put into vegetable production

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside another

parts.note: peas are a vegetable crop
to set something is to put it down

explanation.surface: Overseas money invested in growing greens.
explanation.walkthrough: The peseta was the currency of Spain before the euro.
explanation.definitionFit: Pesetas were the old Spanish currency units, money from abroad to a British solver.

clue.text: Pygmalion's sister got on with none

parts.note: did means fared or got on, as in 'how did you do?'
O as zero means none

explanation.surface: A remark that a mythical sculptor's sister managed without anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: This Pygmalion is the king of Tyre, not the sculptor; his sister founded Carthage.
explanation.definitionFit: In legend Dido, founding queen of Carthage, was the sibling of King Pygmalion of Tyre.

clue.text: The eccentric hands out quite a lot

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, telling you to rearrange the letters of hands out

explanation.surface: An oddball gives things away freely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link word; 'eccentric' rearranges HANDS OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A thousand is a large number, so it stands for a considerable amount.

clue.text: Take only a moment to identify a girl

parts.note: to take a moment is to be a short while, so take gives be
a trice is a moment, as in 'in a trice'

explanation.surface: Pausing briefly to spot a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'only' and 'to identify' are link words; 'it'll only be a trice' means it will take a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatrice is a female given name, so any girl's name fits the definition.

clue.text: Held back from retiring

explanation.surface: Someone stopped short of stepping down.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserved means kept aside for later; it also describes a shy, undemonstrative person.

clue.text: Not the sole list

explanation.surface: A note that the register is not the only one.
explanation.definitionFit: The heel is the back part of a shoe beneath the foot, distinct from its underside; to heel is to tilt, as a ship leans over.

clue.text: Tried a new variety of seed, say

indicators.note: a new variety is a different form, telling you to rearrange the letters of seed and say

explanation.surface: A gardener experimenting with a fresh strain of plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is a link word; 'new variety of' rearranges SEED SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay something is to attempt it, so essayed means attempted.

clue.text: Squirm serving a court order on a man

indicators.note: in a down answer one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: a writ is a written order issued by a court
he is a pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A bailiff delivering legal papers to someone who wriggles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serving' is a link word; 'on' sets WRIT above HE in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To writhe is to twist and wriggle the body, as in pain, so it means squirm.

clue.text: Well of course!

parts.note: reads as an impatient 'naturally!', but a spring is where a river's course begins

explanation.surface: An exasperated agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring or well is the origin of a stream, the point where its course starts.

clue.text: A ship carrying uniform for the under-eights

indicators.note: carrying means the ship holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
even means uniform or regular

explanation.surface: A vessel taking school clothes for young children.
explanation.walkthrough: The under-eights are not young children: in a pack of cards the sevens rank just below the eights.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing cards numbered seven rank immediately beneath the eights in a suit.

clue.text: Giving out notes and jewellery

parts.note: ut is the old name for the note doh in sol-fa
te is a note of the sol-fa scale
a ring is a piece of jewellery

explanation.surface: Distributing banknotes and precious items.
explanation.walkthrough: One word 'notes' supplies two notes, UT and TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Uttering is voicing words aloud, emitting sounds, and also passing forged money into circulation.

clue.text: Make plain a river should be stocked with fish

indicators.note: a river stocked with fish holds them inside it, so one piece goes into another

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another in Wales and England
a cod is a fish

explanation.surface: A remark that an angling river needs to be restocked.
explanation.definitionFit: To decode a message is to translate it into clear language, making it intelligible.

clue.text: Where it's advisable to behave like the natives

definitions.text: Where it's advisable to behave like the natives

parts.words: Where it's advisable to behave like the natives
parts.note: recalls the proverb about doing as the locals do in the Italian capital

explanation.surface: Travel advice on fitting in with locals.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says when in the Italian capital, do as its people do.

clue.text: Fly, a half-dozen scoffed!

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral for six
to scoff food is to eat it greedily, so scoffed gives ate

explanation.surface: Someone guzzled six pastries in one go.
explanation.definitionFit: To aviate is to pilot an aircraft, so it means fly.

clue.text: Read poetry and talk

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or read carefully
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Recite poems and chat about them.
explanation.definitionFit: To converse is to hold a conversation, to chat with someone.

clue.text: Exercise taking animals out — get more involved

indicators.note: out here means outside: the animals stand outside the exercise

parts.note: deer are animals
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: A trainer taking creatures out for a run gets drawn in further.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' and 'get' are link words; DEER goes outside PE.
explanation.definitionFit: Deeper describes something more profound or complicated, like a plot with more layers.

clue.text: She leads maybe, though lacking the brains

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of she leads could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A woman in charge, though rather dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'though' is a link word; 'maybe' rearranges SHE LEADS.
explanation.definitionFit: Headless literally means without a head, and figuratively stupid or lacking sense.
